patch_list: Rodeo Stampede Ad-Free (Ads blocked + instant rewards)
Blocks banner/app-open/native ads and turns rewarded + interstitial ads into instant no-ad events so the game never fetches or displays ads.
Spoofs in-app purchases as instantly successful at the Yodo1 purchase funnel.
